items.title: Moderation admins
items.description: Roles and members who can configure moderation, view the audit log, and take manual actions. The community owner is always elevated regardless of this setting.

items.title: Exempt members
items.description: Roles and members exempt from automated content, spam, and rate-limit rules. Useful for moderators or trusted bots whose messages should never be filtered. Manual admin actions (kick, ban, delete) are unaffected.
